analysis.description: This paper explores the efficacy of a digital game simulator called RETAIN, designed for neonatal resuscitation training for labour and delivery room staff. A randomized controlled trial compared the simulator to traditional video lecture methods to evaluate improvements in neonatal resuscitation knowledge and participant enjoyment.
